⚠️ I would greatly appreciate it if you could consider creating your bot in the fourth level instead of the first one. You can switch between levels by clicking the blue arrow in the top right corner. This would enable me to receive feedback on the dash, bomb, and platform features. Thank you for your understanding.⚠️

  The Goal

The goal of this game is to be the last player standing.

  Rules

During the game, all players control one runner that can move on a 35 by 22 grid in four directions : Left, Right, Up and Down. X=0 Y=0 is the top left cell and X=34 Y=21 is the bottom right one. When a player steps on a cell, it dies four frames later. Some cells will also die randomly.

Each player has a certain amount of mana that goes up by one every time he steps on a cell that is not already decaying. Mana can be used to cast differents spells... But they will only be available in next leagues 😉

If a player goes on a position where the cell is not alive or steps off the grid, the player dies. If there are still two or more players alive after 150 frames, they are tied.

  Example

Players can move their characters using commands such as "MOVE left." To cast a spell, players must use the appropriate syntax, such as "SPELL DASH up 4" to cast the DASH spell upward four cells.
  • Here is an output example of a player that wants to move left :

    MOVE left

    •   Game Input

      Game Input

    Initialisation Input

    Line 1: xSize for the number of cells in each row.

    Line 2: ySize for the number of cells in each column.

    Game loop Input

    Next xSize*ySize lines: these lines describe each cell :

    x and y for the coordinates of the cell.
    dying 1 if the cell is decaying, 0 otherwise.
    life the current cell life, 4 is the healthiest, 0 is dead.
    strong 1 if the cell can only be destroyed with a bomb, 0 otherwise.


    Next line : numberOfBombs indicates the number of bombs that are currently in the game. Bombs cannot be used until league 4. Therefore, any information regarding bombs is irrelevant for now.

    Next numberOfBombs lines : these lines describe each bomb :

    x and y for the coordinates of the bomb.
    timeBeforeExplosion indicates the time in frame before the bomb explodes.

    Next line: player variables (self)

    playerId indicates your player id (always 0)
    playerX and playerY for the coordinates of the player.
    playerMana indicates the amount of mana that the player has.

    Next line: numberOfEnemyPlayers indicates the number of enemy players currently alive.

    Next numberOfEnemyPlayers lines: player variables (enemies)

    enemyPlayerId indicates the enemy player's id
    enemyPlayerX and enemyPlayerY for the coordinates of the enemy player.
    enemyPlayerMana indicates the amount of mana that the enemy player has.

    Output
    A single line containing either...

    MOVE "direction" to move your player to a certain direction, the four possible directions are "left", "right", "up" and "down"

    or

    WAIT to do nothing this frame.
    Constraints
    Allotted response time to output is ≤ 50 ms.

The Goal

The goal of this game is to be the last player standing.

  Rules

During the game, all players control one runner that can move on a 35 by 22 grid in four directions : Left, Right, Up and Down. X=0 Y=0 is the top left cell and X=34 Y=21 is the bottom right one. When a player steps on a cell, it dies four frames later. Some cells will also die randomly.

Each player has a certain amount of mana that goes up by one every time he steps on a cell that is not already decaying. Mana can be used to cast differents spells :
    DASH "direction" "distance" spell that cost 10 mana and allow you to jump 2 to 5 cells in any direction relative to the player
    PLATFORM "x" "y" (global position) spell that cost 10 mana and allow to put a 3x3 platform on any spot in the map. The cells that makes up the palteform are considered "strong" and won't decay if a player step on it but can be destroyed with a bomb. The strong platforms will return to their previous state 4 frames after the event
    BOMB "x" "y" (relative to the player) that cost 10 mana and allow you to place a bomb on the map that will explode 2 frames after the event. The bomb will destroy everything around itself in a 5x5 zone except the corner of said zone. The player can cast it on 15x15 square around himself, if the bomb has no alive cells below it, it will die without exploding.


If a player goes on a position where the cell is not alive or steps off the grid, the player dies. If there are still two or more players alive after 150 frames, they are tied.

  Expert Rules

Every frame, each cell has a 1 in 600 chance of naturally decaying. After 120 frames, cells have a 1 in 20 chance of naturally decaying.
